results.answer:
The rate limit on the bulk export endpoints is 10 requests per minute. This separate, lower limit is applied due to their higher processing cost.

If you exceed this limit, the API returns an HTTP 429 status code with a `Retry-After` header indicating how many seconds you need to wait before retrying. We recommend using exponential backoff with jitter rather than retrying immediately. 

Please note that rate limits are tracked per account rather than per API key, meaning all keys on an account share the same quota. If you have a legitimate use case that requires a higher limit, you can contact support with your expected request volume.
results.reasoning: The agent correctly identifies the rate limit for bulk export endpoints as 10 requests per minute and provides accurate supporting details from the provided documentation without contradicting the reference.
